prompts.title: Fade reel
prompts.summary: A 15-second reel brief for one cut, with the chair spin reveal.
prompts.prompt: Write a 15-second reel brief for a [cut] at [shop]. The first second, three working shots, the chair-spin reveal, on-screen words (five at most), and the caption with the cut's name and price. Only post the client with their OK.
prompts.use: Ask before you film. Most say yes.

prompts.title: Rebook texts
prompts.summary: Texts at two, three and four weeks, by the cut.
prompts.prompt: Write three short rebook texts for [barber] at [shop]: two weeks (fades), three weeks (regular cuts), four weeks (everyone else). Under 25 words, booking link [link].

prompts.title: Chair math
prompts.summary: Compares chair rent and commission at your price and cuts per day.
prompts.prompt: Compare chair rent [$ per week] vs commission [% to me] at [cuts per day], [days per week], average ticket [$], product sales [$]. Show my take-home both ways, and the cuts per week where they break even.
prompts.use: Run it before you sign a chair deal.
